limitations: Case labels and judgments remain declarations; matching citations and artifact bindings do not prove claims.
Host isolation and complete external attempts are not verified.
Profile permits at most one completed claim per trial; broader multi-claim scoring/deduplication remains required.
No numerical probability exists in the candidate contract; confidence/calibration cannot be invented.
Partial/interrupted claims are separately counted as unscored; paired metrics describe completed-review claims.
Optional native skips are unavailable checks, not native acceptance.
Exact engine/runtime-byte identity still applies to frozen benchmark artifacts; legacy plans are not a cross-build artifact compatibility promise.
